player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I added ingredients to the cauldron in the wrong order. The recipe requires the spider to be added second, but I added the banana first, followed by the eye of newt, toad, orange, and apple, completely skipping the spider. I also wasted time trying to get the green beetle from the cellar when the spider was the critical missing ingredient. Next time, I will strictly follow the recipe sequence: first pour ectoplasm, then immediately take and add the spider from the cellar before adding any other ingredients. I will ensure I have the spider in my inventory before attempting to put anything else into the cauldron.
